name: dasa_open

phase_0.boundary_condition: the molecular orbital envelope of the extended push-pull system

VINIT.justification: the unexcited molecular configuration before photon absorption or chemical activation

TANCH.justification: the final stable state within the solvent cage that contains the molecular energy

AFWD.justification: the forward transformation from a cyclic colorless form to an open colored form

AREV.justification: the spontaneous or driven return from the open triene to the closed cyclopentenone

CLINK.justification: the sequential alignment of pi-orbitals to form the extended push-pull system

IMSCRIB.justification: the specific electronic signature and absorption maximum that defines this molecular species

FSPLIT.justification: the splitting of the ground state population into excited singlet and triplet manifolds

FFUSE.justification: the recombination of excited state pathways back into a single ground state potential energy surface

EVALT.justification: the achievement of the trans-cis-trans configuration required for the open form

EVALF.justification: the loss of energy to heat without achieving the structural transformation

ENGAGR.justification: the simultaneous existence of neutral and charge-separated resonance structures in the triene

IFIX.justification: the permanent recording of the absorption event in the instrument log

phase_3.void_description: the vacuum state before molecular synthesis or introduction
phase_3.true_description: the open colored triene state with maximum conjugation
phase_3.false_description: the closed colorless state or degraded byproduct
phase_3.both_description: the transition state where the C-O bond is partially broken and partially formed

steps.domain_action: initialize the molecular system in the ground state
identify the specific donor-acceptor Stenhouse adduct architecture
record the initial concentration and purity of the sample
apply electromagnetic radiation to trigger the forward morphism
branch the population into productive and non-productive electronic states
confirm the attainment of the excited singlet state necessary for opening
execute the sequential rotation of the triene backbone bonds
hold the zwitterionic and neutral resonance forms in simultaneous tension
reunite the electronic pathways into the open ground state manifold
account for the fraction of molecules that undergo vibrational relaxation to the closed form
monitor the reverse thermal pathway to ensure equilibrium control
log the final absorbance value of the open colored form
seal the molecular state within the experimental boundary

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the photon flux and wavelength selection that dictates the reaction coordinate
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the potential energy surface and molecular geometry
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the kinetic rate constants of the isomerization and cyclization steps
phase_5.alfs_store: the CLINK L8 Organism catalog entry for dasa_open

phase_6.cycle_cost: photon energy and solvent reorganization energy
phase_6.post_cycle_state: high-entropy open-chain configuration with solvent stabilization
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the energy consumed in the forward photo-switch is balanced by thermal dissipation in the reverse cycle
